steps.title: Prepare plate and reagents
steps.instruction: Add diluent to the first row of the 12‑row trough and load your samples or standards into column 1 of the 96‑well plate; if a blank is required, leave the first available column empty for the blank.

substeps.instruction: Add diluent (e.g., water or buffer) to row 1 of the 12‑row reservoir.
Add 150 µL of concentrated sample (or your chosen standard) to each well of column 1 of the 96‑well plate.
If a blank will be included, reserve the first empty column for the blank.

steps.title: Select pipette and side
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons Run App, choose the pipette (single‑channel or 8‑channel) you will use and specify the deck side on which it is installed.

steps.title: Set dilution parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the dilution factor, number of dilutions, total mixing volume, and optional air‑gap and tip‑reuse settings; the app will calculate the required transfer and diluent volumes.

substeps.instruction: Set Number of Dilutions (maximum 11; 10 if a blank is used).
Set Total Mixing Volume (e.g., 150 µL) – ensure it does not exceed the well capacity.
The app computes Transfer Volume = Total Mixing Volume ÷ Dilution Factor (e.g., 150 µL ÷ 3 = 50 µL).
Diluent Volume = Total Mixing Volume – Transfer Volume (e.g., 150 µL – 50 µL = 100 µL).
Optionally set an Air Gap volume to be aspirated after each liquid aspiration.
Choose a Tip Reuse Strategy (e.g., reuse tips for all transfers or change each time).
Indicate whether a blank column should be created.

steps.title: Download customized protocol
steps.instruction: Click the blue “Download” button to save the generated OT‑2 Python protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol and set up deck
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons Run App, upload the downloaded protocol file and arrange the deck according to the labware list.

substeps.instruction: Place the 12‑row trough with diluent in the designated slot.
Place the 96‑well plate (Nest 96‑well flat) in the designated slot.
Load the appropriate tip rack (Opentrons 300 µL tips) for the selected pipette.
Verify that the labware definitions match the items listed (trough, plate, tips).

steps.title: Execute serial dilution run
steps.instruction: Start the run; the robot will add the calculated diluent volume (e.g., 100 µL) to each empty well, then transfer the calculated sample volume (e.g., 50 µL) from column 1 to successive wells to generate the desired dilution series.

substeps.instruction: The OT‑2 adds diluent to every well that will receive a dilution.
The OT‑2 aspirates the transfer volume from the source column and dispenses it into the next column, mixing with the diluent to achieve the set dilution factor.
The process repeats for the number of dilutions specified.
